snippet.title: Storyteller Special Edition | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Once upon a time — wait, what comes next again? Drag and drop classic characters onto the page to build surprising stories in this puzzle game.

Play Storyteller - Special Edition on your mobile devices. Available exclusively on Netflix: http://www.netflix.com/game/81569948

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Storyteller Special Edition | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
https://www.youtube.com/@NetflixGames
